configuration.absolute_amplitude: power dBFS, 10*log10(max(power,1e-12)); no event normalization; fixed plot range -100 to 0 dBFS
configuration.channels: arithmetic mono mean for descriptive analysis only
configuration.transient_map: positive dB excursion above per-frequency baseline median
configuration.visual_axes: all sources share -100..100 ms, 20..2000 Hz, -100..0 dBFS

definition.coincidence: nearest already-authorized Drum EME within 0.030 seconds
definition.report: observable NEITHER fractions overall, without Drum coincidence, and without strong Drum coincidence
definition.strong_drum: coincident Drum EME whose original-overhead 20..2000-Hz peak spectral flux is at or above the prospectively specified median across all 909 Drum EME
